name: WindowMenu daily cost
description:
**Conversation Summary**

1. **Request:** Display the amount spent today (cxj coins) inside the `WindowsMenu` trigger button, but only while the menu is expanded.
2. **Discovery:** Today's spend data already existed in the store at `$storex.users.metrics.today.total_cxjcoins`, loaded via `$storex.users.loadMetrics()` (used by `UserInfoPanel.vue` / `UserInfo.vue`).
3. **Solution:** Updated `src/components/main-menu/WindowsMenu.vue` to render a compact coin badge (`fa-solid fa-coins` + formatted amount) right-aligned after the `slot`, gated by `v-if="showTodaySpend"` (`openMenu === 'windows-menu'` and metrics non-null).
4. **Behavior added:** The `openMenu` watcher now calls `loadTodaySpend()` on open, plus new computed properties `todaySpent`, `todaySpentFormatted`, `dailyLimitStatus` — turning the badge `text-warning` normally and `text-error` when the daily spending limit is exceeded.
5. **Design/UX safeguards:** `whitespace-nowrap`, `shrink-0`, `tabular-nums` prevent trigger reflow; `title` + `aria-label` supply the unit ("Spent today: X.XX cxj coins") so meaning is never conveyed by color alone; optional follow-up is a 30s live-refresh interval instead of refresh-on-open.

messages.content: Show the amount expend for the day in the windows menu trigger button when expanded

I'll start by exploring the project to understand the data available for "amount spent for the day".## Review & Understand - Show **today's spent amount (cxj coins)** inside the **`WindowsMenu` trigger**, visible **only while the menu is expanded**. - Data source already exists in the store: `$storex.users.metrics.today.total_cxjcoins` (`API.analytics.me()`), already used by `UserInfoPanel.vue` / `UserInfo.vue`. - Metrics may not be loaded when the menu is first opened → refresh them in the `openMenu` watcher (the same moment `open` is emitted). - Styling must stay inside the design system (DaisyUI/Tailwind tokens, `text-warning` for coins, `text-error` when the daily limit is exceeded), no layout jump for the trigger content. ## Changes Summary | File | Change | |---|---| | `src/components/main-menu/WindowsMenu.vue` | Trigger renders a compact "spent today" badge next to the slot, gated by the menu open state; `openMenu` watcher loads metrics; new computed/method (`todaySpent`, `todaySpentFormatted`, `showTodaySpend`, `dailyLimitStatus`, `loadTodaySpend`). | ## Specifications | Dimension | Decision | |---|---| | Placement | Right-aligned inside `MenubarTrigger` via `ml-auto`, after the `slot` | | Visibility | `openMenu === 'windows-menu'` **and** metrics available (`v-if`) | | Content | `fa-solid fa-coins` + number, `text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums` | | Color | `text-warning` + `bg-warning/15`; `text-error` + `bg-error/15` when the daily limit is exceeded (never color-only — the coin icon + tooltip carry meaning) | | Motion | `transition-all duration-200` | | Data | `$storex.users.metrics.today.total_cxjcoins`, refreshed by `$storex.users.loadMetrics()` on menu open | | Accessibility | `title` + `aria-label` = "Spent today: X.XX cxj coins"; no focus/hover state removed | ## Anti-Patterns to Avoid - ❌ Fetching metrics on every render/tick — do it once per menu open (done in the watcher). - ❌ Letting the number wrap or resize the trigger — `whitespace-nowrap`, `shrink-0`, `tabular-nums` prevent reflow. - ❌ Showing `0.00` when data is unknown — the badge is hidden while `metrics` is `null`. ## Accessibility Checklist - [x] Amount is text (not color/shape only) + `aria-label` with unit - [x] Icon is decorative inside a labelled span — no `alt` needed - [x] No contrast risk: `text-warning`/`text-error` on `*-/15` tinted background in both DaisyUI themes - [x] Trigger keeps its original focus/outline behaviour (`outline-none` preserved as before) - [x] No transition longer than 200ms ## Implementation Steps 1. `MenubarTrigger` now emits `slot` + conditional spend badge (`v-if="showTodaySpend"`). 2. `openMenu` watcher calls `loadTodaySpend()` on open (keeps `open`/`close` events intact). 3. Badge derives from `$storex.users.metrics.today.total_cxjcoins`; `dailyLimitStatus` maps the wallet's `daily` spending limit to `warning`/`exceeded` coloring. 4. Optional next step: if you prefer a live value, reuse the 30s interval pattern from `UserInfo.vue` instead of the on-open refresh.
